study type: Prospective exploratory study nested within a randomized clinical trial
cohort: Pregnant women aged 18 years or older with a singleton fetus in non-cephalic presentation at term, without contraindications to vaginal birth.
finding: Breech progression angle (BPA) measured by transperineal ultrasound does not provide clinically useful information for predicting the success of external cephalic version (ECV), either in breech or transverse lie presentations.
